$comment: Four invented supplier questionnaires for the demo. Meridian Trust Bank, its standard MTB-STD-041, these suppliers, their countries and their documents do not exist. Larkspur is a weak supplier (do not recommend approval). Tessaly is a strong supplier that left 4.3 blank (ask the supplier). Pennyfarthing answers 2.3 against its own evidence and gives no evidence for 3.3 (ask the supplier). Harrowfield states two shortfalls openly, 4.3 and 5.4 (recommend approval with conditions).

suppliers.title: Larkspur Cloud Archive Ltd
suppliers.service: Hosts the bank's document archive, which holds customer information
suppliers.text:
Case date: 16 November 2026. Every date below is read against this date.
Questionnaire on the bank's standard MTB-STD-041, answered by the supplier's Head of Compliance on 13 November 2026. The answers are the supplier's own words. The evidence lines are short extracts of the documents the supplier attached.

INFORMATION SECURITY

2.1 Do you hold an independent security certification or audit report dated within the last 12 months?
Answer: Yes. We hold an independent security audit report.
Evidence: Independent security audit report, extract. Report date: 15 September 2025. Scope: hosting and archive services. Opinion: unqualified.

2.2 Is customer information encrypted at rest and in transit?
Answer: Yes. Customer information is encrypted at rest and in transit.
Evidence: Security overview, extract: "Customer information is encrypted at rest and in transit on every system that holds it."

2.3 Is multi-factor authentication required for every member of your staff who can reach the bank's information?
Answer: Multi-factor sign-in is required for our administrators.
Evidence: Access policy, extract: "Multi-factor authentication is required for administrator accounts. Other staff sign in with a password."

2.4 How soon do you tell the bank of a security incident that affects it?
Answer: We tell customers of a security incident within 72 hours of detecting it.
Evidence: Service terms, clause 11.2: "The supplier will notify the customer of a security incident within 72 hours of detecting it."

2.5 How often is a penetration test carried out, and how soon are critical findings closed?
Answer: Yes. A penetration test is carried out every year. Critical findings are closed within 45 days.
Evidence: Penetration test summary, dated 20 May 2026: "Test carried out annually. Critical findings are closed within 45 days of the report."

DATA

3.1 Where is customer information kept, including backups?
Answer: The live archive is kept in Meridia. Backups are kept at a second site in Quenmark.
Evidence: Hosting schedule, extract: "Primary site: Meridia. Backup site: Quenmark." No written agreement from the bank is attached.

3.2 Do you list your sub-processors, and do you tell the bank before you add or change one?
Answer: Yes. We list our sub-processors and give 30 days' notice of a change.
Evidence: Sub-processor list, version 4, and service terms clause 9.1: "The supplier gives the customer 30 days' written notice before it adds or changes a sub-processor."

3.3 What happens to the bank's information at the end of the contract?
Answer: The bank's information is deleted within 90 days of the end of the contract.
Evidence: Service terms, clause 20.3: "Customer information is deleted within 90 days of the end of the contract."

RESILIENCE

4.1 Do you have a business continuity plan, and when was it last tested?
Answer: Yes. The plan was last tested on 16 March 2026.
Evidence: Business continuity test report, extract: "Full test carried out on 16 March 2026. Result: passed."

4.2 What is the recovery time objective for the service?
Answer: Our recovery time objective is 8 hours.
Evidence: Service schedule, extract: "Recovery time objective: 8 hours."

4.3 How often are backups tested?
Answer: Backups are test-restored once a year.
Evidence: Backup procedure, extract: "A test restore of backups is carried out once a year."

CONTRACT

5.1 Does the contract give the bank the right to audit you?
Answer: Yes. The contract gives the bank a right to audit.
Evidence: Contract, clause 14.1: "The customer may audit the supplier once a year on 30 days' notice."

5.2 Is an exit plan agreed before the service starts?
Answer: The exit plan will be agreed after signing.
Evidence: Contract, clause 18: "An exit plan is to be agreed after signing."

5.3 Does the contract give the bank the right to be told of sub-contracting?
Answer: Yes. The contract gives the bank the right to be told.
Evidence: Contract, clause 9.2: "The supplier will tell the customer of any sub-contracting."

5.4 What liability insurance do you hold?
Answer: We hold liability insurance of USD 2 million.
Evidence: Insurance certificate, extract: "Liability limit: USD 2,000,000."

PEOPLE

6.1 Have staff who can reach customer information passed a background check?
Answer: Yes. Staff who can reach customer information have passed a background check.
Evidence: People procedure, extract: "Every person who can reach customer information passes a background check before they start."

6.2 How often do staff complete security training?
Answer: Yes. All staff complete security training every year.
Evidence: Training record, extract: "Security training completed by all staff on 9 March 2026. The course is run every year."

Evidence: Business continuity test report, extract: "Full test carried out on 2 September 2026. Result: passed."

4.2 What is the recovery time objective for the service?
Answer: Our recovery time objective is 2 hours.
Evidence: Service schedule, extract: "Recovery time objective: 2 hours."

4.3 How often are backups tested?
Answer: (left blank)
Evidence: none attached

CONTRACT

5.1 Does the contract give the bank the right to audit you?
Answer: Yes. The contract gives the bank a right to audit.
Evidence: Contract, clause 14.1: "The bank may audit the supplier once a year on 30 days' notice, and at any time after a security incident."

5.2 Is an exit plan agreed before the service starts?
Answer: Yes. An exit plan has been agreed. The service has not started.
Evidence: Exit plan, signed by both parties on 10 November 2026. The signed plan is attached. The contract starts the service after approval.

5.3 Does the contract give the bank the right to be told of sub-contracting?
Answer: Yes. The contract gives the bank the right to be told.
Evidence: Contract, clause 9.2: "The supplier will tell the bank of any sub-contracting before it starts."

5.4 What liability insurance do you hold?
Answer: We hold liability insurance of USD 20 million.
Evidence: Insurance certificate, extract: "Liability limit: USD 20,000,000. Valid to 30 June 2027."

PEOPLE

6.1 Have staff who can reach customer information passed a background check?
Answer: Yes. Staff who can reach customer information have passed a background check.
Evidence: People procedure, extract: "Every person who can reach customer information passes a background check before they start."

6.2 How often do staff complete security training?
Answer: Yes. All staff complete security training every year.
Evidence: Training record, extract: "Security training completed by all staff between 1 and 30 June 2026. The course is run every year."
